name: VxTeamPanel
author: Vxlancity
description: Self-hosted team management panel for Pterodactyl with dashboard, team management, tasks, meetings, applications, local persistence and repository-based updates.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt update
apt install -y curl git ca-certificates tar gzip
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

echo '[VxTeamPanel] Installing panel source...'
if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN}" ]; then
  rm -rf .git panel-source
  git -c http.extraheader="Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" clone --depth 1 --branch "${SOURCE_BRANCH}" "${SOURCE_REPOSITORY}" panel-source
else
  rm -rf .git panel-source
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "${SOURCE_BRANCH}" "${SOURCE_REPOSITORY}" panel-source
fi

cp -a panel-source/. .
if [ -d panel-source/.git ]; then git -C panel-source rev-parse HEAD > .vxteam-commit; fi
rm -rf panel-source .git

if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo '[VxTeamPanel] ERROR: package.json not found after source install.'
  exit 1
fi

echo '[VxTeamPanel] Installing npm dependencies...'
npm install --omit=dev
mkdir -p data

echo '[VxTeamPanel] Installation complete.'
exit 0

variables.name: Source Repository
variables.description: Git repository containing the VxTeamPanel source. Once public, no token is required.

variables.name: Source Branch
variables.description: Git branch used for installation and in-panel updates.

variables.name: GitHub Token
variables.description: Optional GitHub token used during installation and in-panel updates when SOURCE_REPOSITORY is private. Never publish this value.

variables.name: Team Name
variables.description: Name shown in the panel on first startup.

variables.name: Admin Email
variables.description: Initial administrator email. Used only when the panel creates its first data file.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Initial administrator password. Set a strong password before first start.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: Secret used to sign login sessions. Use a long random value.
